# Refund ticket template

Use this reply template after a refund decision has already been made:

```
Thanks for contacting support about the refund request. We reviewed the account
and applied the decision from the refund policy. The credit memo will appear on
the next invoice if a credit is owed.
```

This template repeats refund language so agents can find the macro quickly, but
it does not define eligibility, annual-plan windows, or cancellation rules.
